title: the WSG injuries and treatment slice - the broken bone, burn, major wound and minor wound rules with the first-aid treatment semantics, printed p. 70
audit_label: R480 WSG injuries treatment pin audit
audit_comment: The injuries and treatment rules: the broken bone (the splint aligns the ends and makes healing possible, no hit points regained until splinted, using the injured extremity even while splinted costs an immediate 1d6 and neutralizes all healing to that time, the broken bone heals last, most other injuries heal before it is mended), the minor burn (deprive the area of air by immersing in water for at least two turns or wrapping tightly with a clean cloth for normal 1-per-day healing, otherwise a -1 pain penalty on attacks and saves and healing at half speed), the major burn (more than half the body burned, treated as above plus rest until at least half the lost hit points are regained, voluntary activity forfeits all regained points and costs 1d4 per round, the pain penalty is -3 instead of -1, the victim can still ride or be carried), the major wound (an edged melee weapon with an unmodified damage roll of 6 or higher, at the DM discretion or on a 25% chance an artery struck, 2-4 as 1d3+1 hit points per round of severe bleeding until tended, pressure applied directly for 2-7 consecutive rounds as 1d6+1 at 1 hit point lost per round meanwhile, wrapping halts the bleeding but recovery needs a healer with the healing proficiency, releasing the pressure early negates the first aid and the bleeding begins again for another 2-7 rounds with the DM free to use the original result or roll again), and the minor wound (any skin-breaking wound is assumed bandaged at the first available opportunity).

banner.title: R480: the WSG INJURIES AND TREATMENT slice, printed p. 70 - the tenth camping-arc round, a pure prose round with NO table: the five specific injuries and their treatments - broken bone, minor burn, major burn, major wound and minor wound - with the general first-aid frame (the skills are common knowledge, useful only when the DM rules with proper reason that a specific injury was suffered).
banner.provenance: The settle: the injuries section lives on the same printed p. 70 already settled for R479 - the tesseract full-text read and the pdfy layout read agree on every number of the section (the tesseract tsv even confirms the dice formulas and ranges cell by cell), so no contested cells and no vision reads were needed. The dice formulas are pinned as dice-plus-modifier consts with the printed ranges as cross-checks: 2-4 as 1d3+1, 2-7 as 1d6+1, the immediate 1d6 and the 1d4 per round.
banner.sentinel: Bounds held: the major burn pain penalty is exactly three times the minor one; both the bleeding and the pressure ranges match their dice-plus-modifier formulas; the artery trigger sits at an unmodified damage roll of 6 or higher with a 25% chance.

consts.name: wtrInjuryTypeCount
consts.comment: five specific injuries: broken bone, minor burn, major burn, major wound, minor wound

consts.name: wtrBurnImmerseMinTurns
consts.comment: immerse the burned area in water for at least two turns

consts.name: wtrHealPerDay
consts.comment: a protected burn heals at the normal rate of 1 hit point per day

consts.name: wtrMinorPainPenalty
consts.comment: an unprotected minor burn: a -1 penalty on all attack rolls and saving throws

consts.name: wtrMajorPainPenalty
consts.comment: a major burn: the pain penalty is -3 instead of -1 on all attack rolls and saving throws

consts.name: wtrHalfNum
consts.comment: the half fraction: one-half of the body, of the lost points

consts.name: wtrHalfDen
consts.comment: both the major-burn body bar and the rest bar use one-half

consts.name: wtrMajorActivityDice
consts.comment: a major burn victim active before recovery takes 1d4 per round

consts.name: wtrMajorActivitySides
consts.comment: the additional damage per round of voluntary activity is 1d4

consts.name: wtrSplintUseDice
consts.comment: using the splinted injured extremity costs an immediate 1d6

consts.name: wtrSplintUseSides
consts.comment: the immediate extra damage for using the injured extremity

consts.name: wtrArteryMinDamage
consts.comment: the major wound trigger: an unmodified damage roll of 6 or higher from an edged melee weapon

consts.name: wtrArteryChance
consts.comment: the DM may rule the artery strike on a 25% chance

consts.name: wtrBleedMin
consts.comment: the severe bleeding loses an additional 2-4 hit points per round

consts.name: wtrBleedMax
consts.comment: the top of the severe bleeding range

consts.name: wtrBleedDice
consts.comment: the severe bleeding is 1d3 + 1 hit points per round

consts.name: wtrBleedSides
consts.comment: the die of the severe bleeding formula

consts.name: wtrBleedPlus
consts.comment: the modifier of the severe bleeding formula

consts.name: wtrPressureMin
consts.comment: direct pressure must be applied for 2-7 consecutive rounds

consts.name: wtrPressureMax
consts.comment: the top of the pressure duration range

consts.name: wtrPressureDice
consts.comment: the pressure duration is 1d6 + 1 rounds

consts.name: wtrPressureSides
consts.comment: the die of the pressure duration formula

consts.name: wtrPressurePlus
consts.comment: the modifier of the pressure duration formula

consts.name: wtrPressureHpLoss
consts.comment: while the pressure is applied the victim loses 1 hit point per round until the time has passed

bools.name: wtrFirstAidCommonKnowledge
bools.comment: the general first-aid skills are common knowledge among most adventurers, usable by anyone with the time and materials

bools.name: wtrDmRulesSpecificInjury
bools.comment: the skills are only useful if the DM rules with proper reason that a specific injury was suffered

bools.name: wtrSplintAlignsBone
bools.comment: putting a splint on the injury keeps the ends of the broken bone properly aligned and makes healing possible

bools.name: wtrSplintRequiredToHeal
bools.comment: no hit points lost to a broken bone in an extremity are regained until the character is fitted with a splint

bools.name: wtrSplintUseExtraDamage
bools.comment: attempting to use the injured extremity even while splinted immediately costs the extra damage

bools.name: wtrSplintUseNeutralizesHealing
bools.comment: the use also neutralizes any healing of the bone up to that time

bools.name: wtrBrokenBoneHealsLast
bools.comment: for a character with several injuries the broken bone is the last injury for which hit points are regained

bools.name: wtrBurnAirDeprivedHeals
bools.comment: depriving the burned area of air - immersion in water or a tight clean-cloth wrapping - lets the burn heal at the normal rate

bools.name: wtrMinorBurnHalfHealUnprotected
bools.comment: an unprotected minor burn heals only half as fast as normal

bools.name: wtrMajorBurnRestRequired
bools.comment: a major burn victim must rest until he has regained at least half of the hit points lost due to the burn

bools.name: wtrMajorBurnForfeitRegained
bools.comment: voluntary activity before recovery forfeits every hit point regained up to that point

bools.name: wtrMajorBurnCanBeCarried
bools.comment: a major burn victim can usually still ride a mount or be carried by a comrade or on a stretcher

bools.name: wtrMajorWoundEdgedOnly
bools.comment: the major wound comes only from an edged melee weapon

bools.name: wtrMajorWoundDmDiscretion
bools.comment: the artery strike is ruled at the DM discretion or on the 25% chance

bools.name: wtrBleedingStemmedByPressure
bools.comment: a comrade or the victim himself - if the wound is in an accessible place - stems the bleeding by applying pressure directly to the wound

bools.name: wtrWrappingHaltsButNeedsHealer
bools.comment: wrapping the wound tightly halts the bleeding, but recovering the lost hit points needs the pressure procedure performed by a character with proficiency in healing

bools.name: wtrPressureReleaseNegates
bools.comment: releasing the pressure before the required time negates the first aid and the bleeding begins again

bools.name: wtrDmMayRerollPressure
bools.comment: for the renewed pressure the DM can use the original result or roll again for added randomness

bools.name: wtrMinorWoundBandageAssumed
bools.comment: any wound that breaks the skin is assumed bandaged at the first available opportunity

examples.note: the pressure duration: 2-7 consecutive rounds as 1d6 + 1

the artery trigger: an unmodified damage roll of 6 or higher, on a 25% chance
